    // The weight of one cell shared equally among its four nodes. Equal sharing
    // is not an approximation: each linear shape function integrates to a quarter
    // of the cell volume, so this IS the consistent load vector of a uniform body
    // force.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Body_force)
    GravityContributions(c: TetrahedronCell, positions: Array<Point3D>, density: Density,
        gravity: Vector3D): Array<DofLoad>
    {
        var share = density.KilogramsPerCubicMeter * c.ToTetrahedron(positions).Volume * 0.25;
        var nodes = c.CellVertices;
        return 12.MapRange(k =>
            DofLoad(DofIndex(nodes[k / 3].Value * 3 + k % 3), gravity.At(k % 3) * share));
    }
```

    // The weight of one plane element shared equally among its three nodes,
    // through the modelled thickness.
    GravityContributions(f: TriangleFace, positions: Array<Point2D>, thickness: Length,
        density: Density, gravity: Vector2D): Array<DofLoad>
    {
        var share = density.KilogramsPerCubicMeter * f.ToTriangle2D(positions).Area
            * thickness.Meters / 3.0;
        var nodes = f.Vertices;
        return 6.MapRange(k =>
            DofLoad(DofIndex(nodes[k / 2].Value * 2 + k % 2), gravity.At(k % 2) * share));
    }
```
